description: This file defines an ApiClient class in Dart for interacting with a backend API using HTTP methods with bearer token support. It provides methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, handling JSON encoding and decoding, along with header management.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A minimal API client for backend services using HTTP with support for bearer tokens and JSON data.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets or clears the bearer token used for authorization.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for HTTP requests, including optional extra headers and authorization token.

methods.name: _u
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object with the base URL, path, and optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the specified path with a JSON body.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends a GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to the specified path with a JSON body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _decode
methods.description: Decodes the HTTP response, parsing JSON for successful responses or throwing an exception for errors.
